subject: Pause request: Skyline Systems pilot — resources moved to platform stability
messages:
From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@skyline.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to pause Skyline pilot — Q4 release focus

Hi Mina / Grace,

Quick heads-up from our side: the exec team just decided to dedicate our engineering org to a platform stability + performance push for the next 8–10 weeks to support the Nov release. That means we need to pause new feature pilots that require engineering time, including the live inference pilot we had scheduled.

Request: can we put the pilot on a soft hold for now? We still want to keep access to any sandbox artifacts and logs you’ve already shared (so our product team can review internally), but we need to free up our engineers for the release sweep.

We expect to revisit in early January after the launch. I’ll confirm a firm date after we return from the customer roadshow. Apologies — this is an internal reprioritization, not a reflection on the pilot itself.

I attached the release roadmap summary for context (Release_Roadmap_Q4.pdf).

Best,
Alex
Director of Product
Skyline Systems

[Attachment: Release_Roadmap_Q4.pdf]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Wu <alex.wu@skyline.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to pause Skyline pilot — Q4 release focus

Thanks for the update, Alex — appreciate the context.

We can absolutely move the pilot to a soft hold. A couple quick things so we don’t lose momentum:
- We’ll keep the evaluation sandbox running and preserve the logs/kv cache snapshots you gave us access to (no changes required on your end).
- Rishi (CS) and Grace (SE) are looped in so they can manage access and notes on the engagement.
- If helpful, we can provide a short, asynchronous summary of results so far (1–2 pages) to keep your PMs aligned without needing engineering time.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll add a short entry to the HubSpot record and tag the deal as "soft_hold_q4_release".
2) We’ll keep the existing sandbox credentials active.
3) Tentative follow-up: first full week of Jan (I can send a few 30-minute options once you confirm availability).

I’m attaching a clean SOW draft (SOW_draft_v2.pdf) and a blank calendar invite — if you want to lock in a tentative Jan date we can place it as tentative on both sides.

No problem at all — we’ll be ready when you are.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-1234

[Attachments: SOW_draft_v2.pdf, calendar-invite.ics]

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@skyline.ai>

Cc: Lara Chen <lara.chen@skyline.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to pause Skyline pilot — Q4 release focus

Thanks Mina — that plan works. A few notes from our side:
- Please keep the sandbox and any data snapshots accessible to our product team. We won’t be making changes, but we want to be able to pick things up in Jan.
- Can Rishi put together a short one-pager on the pilot outcomes so far? That would help when I brief the execs after the roadshow.
- We’ll tentatively aim for the week of Jan 10th for a check-in; I’ll confirm by Dec 20.

Appreciate your flexibility.

—Alex

- Mark HubSpot deal DL-2026-981 as 'On hold - customer reprioritized' and add Alex’s release note PDF to the timeline.
- I’ll draft the one-pager on outcomes (metrics, failure cases, cost summary) — target draft by 12/06.
- Grace: can you export the current sandbox logs and the model KV snapshots to the shared Drive folder (see link Mina added) and leave read access to skyline.ops@skyline.ai?
- Mina: if you want, drop a tentative Jan 10th 30-min hold on both calendars; label it TENTATIVE.

We’ll treat this as nurture — keep the sandbox live and engage only asynchronously until Alex confirms.

-Rishi

- I placed a tentative 30-minute hold for Jan 11, 2027 10:00 AM PST on both sides — please feel free to move or cancel once you have your calendar post-roadshow.

Related links & calendar:
